title: Brian Philpot – Financing Farmers at AgAmerica (Capital Allocators, EP. 296)

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today's show is a sponsored insight from AgAmerica, the largest independent agricultural loan lender and servicer in the US.
reader_summary.overview: Today's show is a sponsored insight from AgAmerica, the largest independent agricultural loan lender and servicer in the US. I sat down with President and CEO, Brian Philpot. Brian invested for twenty-four years in timberland, agricultural, and real estate before turning to a sole focus on farmers.

key_points.text: AgAmerica helps farmers thrive in good times and sleep well in tough times, having originated $2 billion of loans in the past two years.
Our conversation covers Brian's background and path to focusing on the farmer.
We discuss the opportunity set in farm lending and investing, inefficiencies in the market, and AgAmerica's investment process across sourcing, diligence, structuring, operations.
